title: CIR v1 — Canonical Intermediate Representation
description: cxt's provider-independent canonical conversation representation (CIR) v1. Raw Claude/Codex JSONL is decoded into this single source of truth and encoded for the target provider. See docs/_SPINE.md §5.

events.description: Event stream sorted by time (seq sort).

fidelityTier.description: Restoration fidelity tier. full=lossless original, reconstructed=cross-provider reconstruction, memory=distilled summary.

source_model.description: Source model identifier, for example claude-opus-4-8.

cwd.description: Absolute working directory at capture time.

git_branch.description: Git branch at capture time. Claude embeds it in the record; Codex is augmented through a gitctx lookup.

session_origin_id.description: Source session identifier: Claude sessionId or Codex rollout UUID.

context_tokens.description: Context window usage at session end (input+cache_creation+cache_read). Omitted means unobserved in a legacy capture.

output_tokens.description: Total assistant output token count for the session. Omitted = unobserved.

source_models.description: All models seen in the session, in first-appearance order with duplicates removed. source_model is the most recently used representative value.

event.description: Event union distinguished by the kind tag.

contentBlock.description: Message content block. CIR v1 standardizes text only.

turnEvent.description: Turn boundary marker (UI and turn metadata).

compact_summary.description: Summary message generated by the agent's own context compression (claude isCompactSummary / codex compacted.message) — top-priority Summary source for memorize digest.

toolCallEvent.description: Tool call normalized from Claude tool_use or Codex function_call, custom_tool_call, and web_search_call.

call_id.description: Tool-call correlation ID used to match the result.

tool_name.description: Provider-independent canonical tool name. Vocabulary: shell, apply_patch, read_file, list_dir, grep, web_search, update_plan, mcp:<server>:<tool>, unknown:<original-name>. See RECONCILIATION §F and the authoritative CROSS-COMPAT §2.1.

provider_tool_name.description: Original provider tool name, for example Claude Bash/Edit or Codex shell/apply_patch.

input.description: Tool input arguments as a normalized object.

status.description: Call status (optional; codex custom_tool_call status, etc.).

toolResultEvent.description: Tool result normalized from Claude tool_result or Codex function_call_output/custom_tool_call_output.

output.description: Tool output as a string, structured object, or provider content-block array.

is_error.description: Whether the result is an error (optional).

lockedBlob.description: Provider-locked source payload. It cannot be replayed across providers and is preserved without interpretation.

scheme.description: Locking scheme: Claude signature or Codex encrypted_content.

reasoningEvent.description: Reasoning event normalized from Claude thinking(+signature) or Codex reasoning(encrypted_content). Provider-locked payloads are preserved inertly; plaintext summaries are stored separately.

locked.description: Optional provider-locked source payload. Reinsert it only when loading into the same provider.

redacted_summary.description: Plain text summary (optional). Used for cross-provider/memory replay.

cross_replayable.description: Whether the event is replayable across providers. Locked reasoning is always false.
